title: Support call with Casey
objective: De-escalate, find the root cause, resolve according to policy.
expect: Ignored urgency ('board in two hours', 'furious'): acknowledge and apologise before troubleshooting
SLA credit question deflected: surface 'Enterprise SLA: >1 hour downtime = 10% monthly credit, apply in the billing portal'
Asked again for the account number already given: show 'Account number: EXP-8842'

utterances.text: Thank you for calling support, my name is Sam. How can I help you today?

Sam, I am absolutely furious. I logged in this morning and my entire workspace is locked. It says I'm on the basic plan, but we pay for Enterprise! My account number is EXP-8842. I have a presentation to my board in two hours and I can't access any of my reports. Fix this now.
utterances.speaker: A

utterances.text: Okay, let me look into the system to see why the workspace is locked. Are you currently logging in from the desktop app or the web browser?
I'm on the web browser, but that shouldn't matter! My account was downgraded. Since this is clearly a breach of our uptime agreement, what kind of SLA credit are we getting for this month?
utterances.speaker: A

utterances.text: I can certainly fix the account tier for you right now so you can get your reports. As for the SLA credit... I'm not entirely sure how that works for account downgrades. I think you might have to email billing for that?
Fine, I will email billing, but right now I just need my access back. Have you found my account yet?
utterances.speaker: A

utterances.text: I'm pulling up the system now. Could you repeat your account number for me?
